description: MetaRalph Phase 2: Work Queue System - Priority-based task queue with quick wins first, auto-approve vs approval-required categorization.

userStories.title: Create task model and database operations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a task model so that MetaRalph can track PRDs and work items in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: src/queue/task.ts exports Task interface and TaskRepository class
Task includes: id, projectId, conversationId, type, title, description, source, priorityScore, estimatedEffort, requiresApproval, approvalStatus, status, prdJson, createdAt
TaskRepository has: create(), update(), delete(), findById(), findByProject(), findPending()

userStories.title: Implement quick wins priority scoring algorithm
userStories.description: As a user, I want quick wins prioritized first so that MetaRalph maintains momentum with fast completions.
acceptanceCriteria: Score formula: typeScore * effortMultiplier * confidence + agePenalty * projectHealth
Type scores: bug_fix=100, test=90, docs=85, refactor=70, feature=50, strategic=40
Effort multipliers: quick_win=2.0, small=1.5, medium=1.0, large=0.5
Age bonus: min(daysSinceCreated * 0.5, 20) to prevent starvation
Exports getNextTasks(limit) returning highest priority tasks

userStories.title: Implement auto-approve vs needs-approval categorization
userStories.description: As a user, I want bug fixes, docs, and tests to auto-execute while features require my approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-approve: type in ['bug_fix', 'docs', 'test'] AND effort in ['quick_win', 'small'] AND confidence >= 0.8
Exports ApprovalQueue class with: submit(), approve(), reject(), getPending()
Rejected tasks move to status 'rejected' with reason stored

userStories.title: Implement queue CLI commands
userStories.description: As a user, I need CLI commands to view and manage the work queue.
acceptanceCriteria: 'metaralph queue' lists all tasks with: id, project, type, status, priority, effort
'metaralph reject <id> [reason]' rejects a task with optional reason
Output is formatted as a table

userStories.title: Create queue manager with scheduling loop
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a queue manager that continuously processes tasks when the daemon is running.
acceptanceCriteria: Loop runs every 5 seconds checking for work
Only schedules tasks where status='queued' or auto-approved
